name: compare-hero
description: Compare hub hero: a centred eyebrow, H1, lede and one button over the soft 2026 colour wash, above a wide illustration (the Asset Panda panda arm-wrestling a rival) that fades into white at the foot of the hero. Figma: Desktop - Compare > Hero Section (7333:173311).

title.description: The H1, e.g. Find the right asset management solution for your team. Line breaks are kept.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the title, e.g. COMPARE ASSET PANDA PRO.

lede.description: Paragraph under the title. Line breaks are kept.

cta_label.description: Button text, e.g. Book a Demo. Renders only with cta_url.

image.description: Illustration under the copy (transparent WebP or PNG, cropped to the part Figma shows: 1536 x 548 for the 1090 x 389 slot). Empty leaves the hero as copy only.

image_alt.description: Alt text of the illustration. Leave empty when it is decoration (the copy carries the message).

image_w.description: Intrinsic width of the illustration in px (sets its aspect ratio).

image_h.description: Intrinsic height of the illustration in px.

layout.description: wide: the 2026-10-28 frame (1090px illustration under the copy, 797px hero). compact: the 2026-10-29 redesign (Figma 7333:173311, 661px): the copy 57px under the header, an 811px illustration slot (give the art already cropped to that window, e.g. 1427 x 523) whose top tucks 56px under the button row, the optional glow behind it, and a shorter white fade.

glow.description: Compact layout only: soft light image drawn behind the illustration (Figma 'image 11', a 1443 x 563 window centred on the art and starting 266px above it at 1440). Transparent WebP. Decorative.
